response_contract.scientific_semantics: Distinct immutable DOI release; not a licence for 2026 WGLC or raw WWLLN. PANGAEA landing page explicitly CC BY 4.0 and gives ZIP locator https://store.pangaea.de/Publications/KaplanJ-LauH_2019/WWLLN.zip. On 2026-11-25 bounded HTTPS GET on macOS downloaded 37038662 bytes, SHA-256 ef9ef83797f861c68930856ab4f57e392d575c79e7ca46bc7c2f8cf13e19f7d5. ZIP CRC check passed; two entries WWLLN_climatology.nc (5947906 bytes) and WWLLN_monthly.nc (31343698 bytes). HDF5 inspection of climatology verified lon 720, lat 360, time 12, lightning shape 12 x 360 x 720, units strokes km-2, CF-1.7 and source AE detection-efficiency corrected stroke counts. Calendar units days since 0000-01-01 00:00:00 require explicit CF calendar handling; monthly file not yet parsed. Stroke counts not optical flashes; monthly density cannot track storms. Open-first priority: complete exact archive reuse/API review, inspect monthly data/missingness/cell-area and compare to independent radar hail frequencies. No raw bytes in Git or Neon; not admitted. Subsequent same-day offline inspection of the retained original ZIP parsed the full monthly member (31343698 bytes, SHA-256 eb43bf169e7b3c7ec67bfb0a067e0e7a4475b2f84e503a05139e9a74bafbe694). Float32 lightning shape 108 x 360 x 720; coordinate centers lat -89.75 to 89.75, lon -179.75 to 179.75, strictly increasing. Time is strictly increasing from 0 to 3256 days since 2010-01-01, explicit 365_day calendar; do not interpret as Gregorian offsets. All 27993600 stored values finite and not fill (NaN), 20306788 zero, no negatives, range 0 to 14.3060941696167 strokes km-2; every month has 259200 finite cells. Numeric completeness is not detection coverage or physical no-lightning evidence. Provider variable long_name says flashes but units and documentation explicitly describe strokes. Retain stroke semantics; verify geographic/time detection bias and area weights before modelling. PANGAEA exact DOI still explicitly CC BY 4.0; platform terms https://www.pangaea.de/about/terms.php section 5.5 restrict mass retrieval and automated commercial web-page extraction absent authorization. Data reuse with attribution is distinct from automated access; no new live request authorized here.
